blocks.text: The module documentation defines transactional sequence allocation, canonical JSON, append-only behavior, read semantics, and secure JSONL export.
blocks.title: Event-log guarantees

blocks.text: Event is the parsed row value. Type validation bounds event names, while row conversion parses the canonical JSON column.
blocks.title: Event representation and validation

blocks.text: append_events validates and serializes every item before opening a transaction, checks the session, allocates MAX(seq)+1, and returns stored Event values. append_event is the one-item wrapper.
blocks.title: Transactional append

blocks.text: last_seq reports the highest local sequence, while iter_events applies an after-sequence filter and optional limit. read_events materializes the iterator.
blocks.title: Ordered reads

blocks.text: _export_line validates stored JSON and creates a fixed-key JSON object. iter_export_lines orders one session by seq or all sessions by creation metadata and seq.
blocks.title: Export line construction

blocks.text: _write_lines counts emitted lines. export_jsonl accepts a text stream directly or writes through a 0600 temporary file, fsyncs it, and atomically replaces the target.
blocks.title: Stream and atomic file export

gotchas: Unknown sessions raise for append and export but read helpers return empty results.
Payload serialization happens before the transaction.
Stored event data is included verbatim in exports.
how_it_works: Validates type names and canonicalizes payloads before locking
Appends one or many events under the database transaction helper
Reads by session and sequence cursor
Writes JSONL to streams or atomically replaces a destination file
purpose: This store module assigns contiguous per-session sequence numbers inside transactions, canonicalizes JSON payloads, reads events in order, and exports one or all sessions. Filesystem exports use a private temporary file, fsync, and atomic replacement.
summary: Maintains the append-only SQLite event log and exports it as deterministic JSONL.

symbols.summary: Represents one parsed append-only event row.
Validates an event type is a bounded nonempty string.
Appends multiple canonicalized events with contiguous sequence numbers in one transaction.
Returns the highest local sequence for a session, or zero.
Iterates session events after an optional sequence in ascending order.
Validates stored payload text and formats one deterministic JSONL object.
Returns ordered JSONL lines for one session or the complete event log.
Writes newline-terminated export lines and counts them.
Exports events to a stream or atomically replaces a filesystem destination.
